memories.title: SQLite WAL prevents reader-writer blocking
memories.body: Enable SQLite WAL mode and keep write transactions short. A concurrent regression test verified that readers continue while a writer commits.

memories.title: Prefer compact interfaces without pill badges
memories.body: The user directly stated a durable preference for compact controls and no pill-shaped badges.

memories.title: Railway is the deployment target
memories.body: The project decision is to deploy the API on Railway and keep PostgreSQL in the same environment.

memories.title: Nightly import failed on malformed CSV
memories.body: The September import incident was caused by an unquoted comma in a vendor CSV. Input validation now rejects the row before ingestion.
